title: Ordnungspolizei Doppelkasten radiograms of 27 February 1942 (Weierud 2020, NARA RG 457)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 457 HCC Boxes 1386 and 202 (GPD 665 items 1-5); messages D33, D34, E72, D67
documents.route: Rovno, Mogilev, Proskurov -> Berlin and regional stations

plaintext.source: Bletchley decrypts should be in TNA HW 16/17, not online.

transcription.notes: Seven parts under one daily key; two illegible letters.

system.summary: Doppelkasten: double Playfair with two 5x5 boxes, plaintext in double lines of 17, each pair enciphered twice through the same boxes; one daily key of 27 Feb 1942 (four discriminators).
system.notes: Spelling conventions CH->Q, ß->SZ, X for punctuation; four discriminators per daily key. Whether boxes were random or keyword-built is unknown.

prior_solution.where: The 27 Feb messages are unread in public (Schmeh 2021 list); Bletchley's decrypts should be in TNA HW 16/17, not online. A115 (16 June, a different key) has a decrypt: entry orpo1942jun.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: dk.py (reference implementation checked on both manuals)

solution.what: Read both German key manuals and NSA articles; confirmed double pass from November 1941.
Discriminators show the seven 27 Feb parts share one key (970 letters).
Single encipherment, all line lengths and pair orders.
Double encipherment by annealing and related searches on a synthetic 970-letter text with known key.
Known-plaintext solver recovers the boxes from about 80-111 pairs on synthetic data.
Key-free alignment of Hanyok's A115 text to its ciphertext over many spellings and layouts.

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): A115 (16 June 1942, discriminator ARTTN, a different daily key with a Bletchley decrypt) moved to orpo1942jun; this entry keeps the seven parts of 27 Feb 1942 (D33, D34, E72, D67). C43 (XOS = OSX) may share the 27 Feb key but is not listed: its date is not verified.

outcome.method_basis: Ciphertext-only attacks on the double-pass Doppelkasten (annealing, SAT, relaxation) failed on the 970-letter 27 Feb key and on a synthetic control of the same size; a known-plaintext solver needs about 80 pairs, and the A115 decrypt (a different key) could not supply them.
outcome.notes: Needs about 80 known plaintext pairs for the 27 Feb key (Bletchley's German decrypts in TNA HW 16/17).

credits.note: German Police Doppelkastenschlüssel Messages (CryptoCellar 2020): the six messages from NARA RG 457, source of the ciphertext
